title: Customers with zero orders (NOT EXISTS)
prompt: Return the names of customers who have NOT placed any orders, using NOT EXISTS.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE cust7 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO cust7 VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Carol'); CREATE TABLE ord7 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO ord7 VALUES (1,1),(2,3);
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM cust7 c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord7 o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id);
